spec.moment: Eating gas station nachos alone in the car after finally getting it back from the tow yard in the rain.

elements.name: the car
elements.look: a small boxy hatchback, dark blue, rain-beaded, parked crookedly

elements.name: gas station nachos
elements.look: a bright orange tray of tortilla chips under a glossy cheese pump, a few jalapeño slices on top

elements.name: the tow yard guy
elements.look: a stocky man in a gray work jacket behind a small lit service window

elements.name: the tow yard
elements.look: a gravel lot fenced with chain link, a few cars parked in rows, a small lit office hut at the back edge

elements.name: the rain
elements.look: wet shiny asphalt with puddles reflecting orange lamp light

spec.scene: A wet gravel patch of tow yard at night, chain-link fence along the back edge with a few parked cars and a small office hut, its window glowing warm. Center-front sits a dark blue hatchback, rain-beaded and shiny, an orange tray of nachos with glossy cheese resting on its hood. To the left a stocky man in a gray work jacket stands at the lit window. Puddles across the gravel mirror the orange lamps, and a green trash can leans by the fence.
spec.title: Nachos After the Tow
spec.caption: Ninety-five bucks later, I ate gas station nachos in my car and laughed.
